scope: Tracked-file hashes, symlinks, Python AST syntax, static capability searches
limitation: A static triage inventory, not a security certification. Data text remains untrusted.

disposition.jevbench: Import public data only; compare scorer bytes with already reviewed vendored scorer.
disposition.SemIf-OpenJev: Import authored/perturbation data; preserve ordered argmax and family-balanced reporting.
disposition.kev: Import v9 split data/manifests only; preserve original labels and unknown-evidence controls.
disposition.MMLU-Pro: Reference code only. Do not run remote-code loaders, provider clients, installers or retry-on-wrong paths.
disposition.MMLU-Pro-data: Resolve only two pinned Parquet LFS objects; use a retained offline reader for conversion.
